name: codex-plugin-to-claude
description: Keeps Codex in the lead and asks Claude for bounded read-only review on important work.

interface.shortDescription: Claude cross-review for high-risk Codex work
interface.longDescription: Codex remains the primary developer while Claude independently reviews a bounded sanitized brief. Explicit requests run directly; high-risk work asks for approval first. Reviews return PASS, FAIL, or ASK and never grant Claude repository tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-plugin-to-claude to cross-review this important change.
Ask Claude to challenge this diagnosis before I implement it.
Have Claude review this tested fix for material risks.
